[P2] Supply the required design and decision rationale

Rules 2, **Simplify before you add**, and 3, **Write a design note before the code**, require the problem, cause, alternatives including simplification, and selection rationale. The description and ownership document describe the implementation without that comparison. Rule 7 also requires reasons for uncovered decisions; the 200 ms deadline margin and 500 ms warm-work wait are not explained in the description. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6), provide the required note and decision rationale, and obtain agreement before continuing implementation.
